question: Should OpenClaw expose outbound delivery failures to agents as a shared system event, a structured message-tool/agent delivery status contract, or both?
rationale: The decision changes model-visible context, plugin/channel SDK expectations, and recovery semantics, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Shared typed delivery contract
options.body: Define one delivery-failure/status contract on top of the existing durable outbound outcomes and choose the agent observation surface before implementation.

options.title: Tool/status only
options.body: Keep session context unchanged and expose failures only through structured message-tool or agent command results.

options.title: Keep narrow paths
options.body: Treat the current CLI, cron, restart recovery, and channel-specific handling as sufficient and later close this request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Shared typed delivery contract
recommendation.body: Define one delivery-failure/status contract on top of the existing durable outbound outcomes and choose the agent observation surface before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The central outbound, channel delivery, and agent runtime history most strongly routes through this owner.
